title: Building a Testing Rig in Waretown NJ
description:
A few months of building a Navy testing rig, compressed into a few minutes.

We built this rig in Waretown, New Jersey, during 2020–2021. The long hair and all the masks should help place it in the COVID era.

I managed to convince the Navy to let us build it in an unused boat bay at a marina in Waretown—which had the very convenient benefit of letting me commute by boat. Every day, I’d leave Island Heights, cruise about 15 miles down Barnegat Bay, dock at the marina, and get to work. Hard to beat that commute.

This time-lapse captures several months of the build. I can’t share much about the specific testing, but the project was ultimately successful and provided data that was instrumental in helping the Navy improve the performance of one of its ship classes.

A rewarding engineering project, with a pretty good ride to the office.

title: Mid Atlantic Cruise Current and Tide Predictor
description:
Spend more time cruising and less time fighting the current. This interactive tidal-current calculator helps you compare departure times and see how currents affect your trip. Choose your route, date, and boat speed, then explore maps and charts to find favorable travel windows along the coast from the C&D Canal to Nantucket.

Built out of my own boating curiosity—and a preference for having the water help push the boat.
